description: This file contains test cases for a FastAPI application using pytest and FastAPI's TestClient. It tests HTTP endpoints, including retrieving items, creating items, and fetching the OpenAPI schema, with fixtures to set up the test client dynamically importing the app module.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module and creates a TestClient for testing the FastAPI app.

methods.name: test_post_items(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the POST /items/ endpoint to create a new item and checks for a successful response and correct message.

methods.name: test_get_items(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the GET /items/ endpoint to retrieve the list of items and verifies the response data.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the GET /openapi.json endpoint to validate the OpenAPI schema returned by the application.
